review_summary: The plan covers every deferred item plus the plugin.json bake, and its central code claims check out: inferProjectFromFile has exactly one caller, the dead-export spot-checks hold, and check-embed-assets leaves embedded-assets.ts on disk. The main risks are in Task 1. The 'no file args → per-file headers' rule contradicts the DoD that a plain `bun test` stays project-wide. The command isn't threaded to sidecarTddTrack today. jest/vitest output isn't parsed, so users' Angular/NestJS projects keep the race. The `[]` versus `null` split can strand TEST_WRITTEN rows.

issues.title: D2 header fallback contradicts the DoD 'full bun test still transitions project-wide'
issues.description: D2 says: when the command names no test files, use the runner's per-file headers. The Task 1 DoD says: 'A full `bun test` (no args) still transitions project-wide'. A full bun run prints a header for every file, so under D2 it becomes a scoped transition that only matches rows through test_file_path or getExpectedTestPaths. That is not project-wide. Any row whose test lives outside the companion layout would never be promoted by confirm_red. A TEST_WRITTEN row that is never promoted to RED makes the TDD guard block the implementation edit, which is the failure this plan is meant to remove.
issues.suggested_fix: In testFilesFromRun, return null (project-wide) whenever the command names no test-file or directory argument (for example `bun test`, `bun test --timeout …`, `npm test` with no file args). Use headers only to resolve directory or pattern args. Add a unit test: `bun test` with headers present → null.

issues.title: The command is not passed to sidecarTddTrack; 'available at :707/:897' is not proven at :842
issues.description: sidecarTddTrack(sidecar, tool, filePath, bashOutput, projectIdentity) (sentinal.ts:317, called at :842-848) takes no command. The only `args.command` read in this area is at :897, inside the memory-capture block after the tracker call. The plan does not show that `args` is in scope at :842. It also does not show that `args` is `input.args` rather than a local variable scoped to that block. Pre-Mortem 1 names this failure but no task step addresses it.
issues.suggested_fix: Task 1: add a `command?: string` parameter to sidecarTddTrack, read it from the tool-call args at the :842 call site (lift the args extraction above the TDD block if needed), and pass `testFilesFromRun(...)` into `transitionTddState(sidecar, action, projectPath, testFiles)`. The plugin test must go through `tool.execute.after` with a real args shape.

issues.title: jest/vitest outputs and npm/npx/nx wrappers are not parsed, so user projects keep the race
issues.description: Sentinal targets Angular/NestJS projects that mostly use jest or vitest (' PASS src/x.spec.ts', ' FAIL src/x.spec.ts', ' ✓ src/x.spec.ts (3 tests)', ' ❯ src/x.spec.ts'), run through `npx jest a.spec.ts`, `npm test -- a.spec.ts` or `nx test`. D2 mentions only bun's `path:` headers and `bun test` args. Every non-bun run would come back unknown, stay project-wide, and keep the race the user asked to fix.
issues.suggested_fix: Extend D2 to strip wrappers (npx/bunx/pnpm/yarn/`npm test --`/`npm run test --`) before reading file args, and to parse jest PASS/FAIL and vitest ✓/❯/FAIL/× header lines. Add unit tests using those real output shapes; the Testing Strategy already mentions vitest.

issues.title: `testFiles: []` → no transition is a silent-miss hazard; the CC failure path has truncated output
issues.description: The plan says '`testFiles: []` means nothing ran → no transition'. On Claude Code, a failing run arrives through PostToolUseFailure `error`, which may be middle-truncated, so headers can be missing. A parser that returns [] for 'no headers found' would never confirm RED. On the plugin side, an old sidecar ignores testFiles (project-wide), while a new sidecar given [] does nothing, so the two diverge.
issues.suggested_fix: Specify that testFilesFromRun never returns [] from missing evidence, only null. Have the route and bulkTddTransition treat an empty array the same as absent (project-wide), or reject it. Add a test: truncated failure output with no headers and no file args → project-wide confirm_red.

issues.title: Matching through getExpectedTestPaths is unverified for __tests__/ and tests/ layouts and for set_state rows with no test_file_path
issues.description: D1 matches rows through test_file_path, or through getExpectedTestPaths(file_path) intersecting testFiles. Rows written by `tdd_set_state` without test_file_path depend entirely on getExpectedTestPaths (src/utils/tdd.ts:114-153). If that helper does not produce `__tests__/x.test.ts` or `tests/x.test.ts`, a scoped run of that test never transitions the row. The Risks table says 'Medium', but the mitigation is only 'tests with real layouts', which is not tied to any task.
issues.suggested_fix: In Task 1, add route tests for rows with test_file_path=NULL whose test lives in a sibling file, in `__tests__/`, in top-level `tests/`, and in `.spec.ts`. As a fallback, also match when getImplPathForTest(testFile) === row.file_path, so both mapping directions are tried.

issues.title: Wave 1 tasks share generated build outputs
issues.description: Tasks 1, 3 and 5 all run `bun run build:opencode` and embed-assets, writing targets/opencode/dist/sentinal.mjs and src/cli/embedded-assets.ts, in one shared working directory (Worktree: No). Task 3 also rewrites targets/claude-code/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, which embed-assets reads. plan_impact checks only the declared Files, so concurrent rebuilds can give another task a stale or half-written bundle, and target-assets.test.ts results become order-dependent.
issues.suggested_fix: Either move Task 3 (or Task 5's bundle verification) to Wave 2, or add a wave note: only run build:opencode/embed-assets and target-assets.test.ts after the other Wave 1 tasks finish, and rebuild at the end of the wave.

issues.title: pre-release.mjs bake must not leave a dirty plugin.json; check how Claude Code treats the new version
issues.description: D6 has both release-build.mjs and pre-release.mjs write `version` into targets/claude-code/.claude-plugin/plugin.json. A local pre-release run would then leave that tracked file modified. The plan also does not check (a) whether `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` has its own version field that would now disagree, or (b) Claude Code's update behaviour: once plugin.json has an explicit version, updates key off that version rather than the commit, so source/git installs between releases would not refresh. .releaserc.json:18 git assets currently list only package.json, VERSION, CHANGELOG.md, so adding plugin.json there is correct.
issues.suggested_fix: In pre-release.mjs, bake into a temp copy, or restore the file afterwards (verify with git status in a test). Grep `targets/claude-code/.claude-plugin/` for any other version field and keep them in sync. Record the CC update-detection behaviour change in Task 9 docs.

issues.title: Check isErrorEvent and probeDashboardHealth against src/index.ts before dropping `export`
issues.description: src/index.ts re-exports named symbols from ./memory/capture.js (block ending at :46) and ./dashboard/lifecycle.js (block ending at :198). Grep confirms both functions are used only in their own files inside src/ (plus the generated embedded-assets.ts copy). I did not verify whether either name appears in those index.ts export lists. If one does, dropping `export` breaks the public API and tsc.
issues.suggested_fix: Task 8: before each change, run `rg -n '\bisErrorEvent\b|\bprobeDashboardHealth\b' src/index.ts`. For the whole list, compare the export surface of src/index.ts before and after (Truth 7).

issues.title: bun `--test-name-pattern` and substring filters
issues.description: `bun test foo` treats a non-path arg as a path substring filter. `bun test -t name` runs a subset of tests while still printing file headers. A passing name-filtered run does not show that the RED tests passed, but D2 would still confirm_green every matching file.
issues.suggested_fix: In testFilesFromRun, return null (project-wide, today's behaviour) when -t/--test-name-pattern is present, or skip confirm_green for filtered runs. Cover this with a unit test.

issues.title: CI step order has a redundant generate step and a plugin type-check that may not port
issues.description: check-embed-assets.mjs already runs `bun run embed-assets` (:36) and leaves src/cli/embedded-assets.ts on disk, so D5's separate 'embed-assets (generate)' step is redundant. The plugin type-check script lives in `.sentinal/skills/.../typecheck-plugin.sh`, and nothing verifies that it runs on ubuntu-latest (bash paths, a temp dir, any macOS-only tools).
issues.suggested_fix: Drop the extra generate step, or keep it and note that it duplicates check-embed-assets. Before Task 10 relies on typecheck-plugin.sh, run it in a Linux container (or read it for mac-isms), or expose it as a `typecheck:plugin` package script.

issues.title: The new service-dedupe.ts would pair with an existing test that targets service.ts
issues.description: src/memory/service-dedupe.test.ts already exists and tests MemoryService through service.ts. Creating src/memory/service-dedupe.ts makes that test its companion by name, while the new file's own test coverage stays implicit. That misleads the TDD guard and companion-test checks.
issues.suggested_fix: Either name the new module something like `service-dedupe-path.ts`, or intentionally re-point service-dedupe.test.ts to import from the new module and state that in Task 4.

issues.title: Removing inferProjectFromFile also means deleting its tests and doc references
issues.description: inferProjectFromFile is used only by tdd-routes.ts:18,210, so it can be removed. Its callers and references are tdd-routes.test.ts:478 (asserts the 'inferred projectPath' log), project-key.test.ts:71,123-134, project-key.ts:24 (doc comment), and the rule files sentinal-project.md:145,160 and sentinal-sidecar.md:66. Task 2 lists project-key.test.ts; it should also name the comment and the rows Task 9 must remove.
issues.suggested_fix: Task 2: delete the `inferProjectFromFile (D4)` describe block and the import, update the project-key.ts:24 header comment, and change tdd-routes.test.ts:478 to assert the REJECTED log. Task 9: remove the :94 table row and the D4 inference paragraph.
